correctness.rationale: The proof reduces domination to the exact condition that the Cartesian product of uncovered rows and uncovered columns consists only of deleted matching cells. Minimality then gives four exhaustive support patterns and converts the singleton-hole pattern to inclusion-minimal edge covers of a smaller punctured board. The remaining parameter cases are explicit. Direct exhaustive enumeration for all parameters with \(1\le a\le b\le4\) and explicit negative witnesses over a much larger finite range agree with every boundary case. The computation is corroborative rather than the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete infinite-family classification directly inside the bipartite WED structural problem highlighted in 2026. It is not a routine numerical increment: deleting a matching creates a new infinite unbalanced WED family \(K_{2,b}-M_2\) and two isolated exceptional parameter triples, and the proof identifies a reusable exact reduction of minimal edge domination to minimal edge covers on a punctured board.
